name: Niizuma Megu ga Ochiru Toki
source:
"I believe in you ..."

Riku Tachibana married his childhood friend, Megumi, and had a happy marriage.
However, he has been busy with work lately and has been unable to spend time with his wife.

One time, on their wedding anniversary, he invited his boss, Gouda, to his house...

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ354914.html/]DLsite[/url]]
